### `Joint`

Joints (spec 19 §19.5.4, P3). Every joint takes an optional `id` (the id rules of spec 1
§1.4); diagnostics name joints by it.

One of:

- object {`id`, `a`, `b`, `at`, `limits`, `motor`, `type`}: Hinge.
- object {`id`, `a`, `b`, `anchorA`, `anchorB`, `length`, `type`}: Rope.
- object {`id`, `a`, `b`, `anchorA`, `anchorB`, `restLength`, `stiffness`, `damping`, `type`}: Spring.
- object {`id`, `a`, `b`, `type`}: Weld.
- object {`id`, `from`, `to`, `anchorFrom`, `anchorTo`, `links`, `length`, `linkWidth`, `style`, `settle`, `motionBlur`, `type`}: Chain sugar.
